item.title: 0.8.5-preprod.1
item.description:
MuesliPreprod 0.8.5-preprod.1

Pre-production build for validating the Sparkle update flow before a stable release.

Install

  • Download MuesliPreprod-0.8.5-preprod.1.dmg
  • Open the DMG and drag MuesliPreprod to Applications
  • Launch MuesliPreprod from Applications

Notes

  • Installs alongside production Muesli.
  • Stores data separately in ~/Library/Application Support/MuesliPreprod/.
  • Uses the pre-production Sparkle feed: https://muesli-hq.github.io/muesli/appcast-preprod.xml.
  • Does not update the production appcast, public download page, or Homebrew tap.
